messages:
maria: Customer request to onboard Verdant-15B (fp16) into Dedicated for inference. They need ~300 rps burst, latency p95 < 250ms, and HIPAA compliance. Linking spec: https://corp.example.com/verdant-request
aj: Thanks — can you paste the model artifact SHA and the hf or s3 link?
maria: s3://cust-models/verdant-15b/v1/model.pt, sha256: 3f2a9b...
devon: Quick checklist: 1) verify tokenizer compatibility, 2) run basic perf smoke with fp16, 3) try 4-bit quantization candidate, 4) run eval suite on privacy prompt set.
sophia: Re tokenizer: appears to be standard bpe. I'll run tokenization diff against our canonical vocab.
quant-bot: automated: queued quantization job (job_id=Q-4823). Will run int8 and nf4 on a single A100-80GB instance. ETA 45m.
maria: Customer prefers int8 if quality drop < 2% on rouge/semantic-similarity. Also flagged hallucination sensitivity for medical content.
aj: Devon/sophia — can we get a quick baseline perf on fp16 within today? If not, set expectation with customer.
devon: I can spin up a dedicated smoke node. Command I'll run:
```bash
python serve_smoke.py --model s3://cust-models/verdant-15b/v1/model.pt --dtype float16 --batch 1 --seq 512
```
I'll post logs.
sophia: Tokenizer diff looks clean: 0.03% OOV on our medical prompts. Sharing sample mismatch in thread.
quant-bot: update: int8 (nf4) candidate completed. size: 28GB, perf delta: +1.8x tokens/sec vs fp16. Eval pending.
rachel: I'll queue the privacy-sensitive eval set and the hallucination checklist against both fp16 and nf4. Running runner id E-7712.
maria: Also confirm inference fallback policy: if nf4 drops quality >2% we need automatic fallback to fp16. Customer expects no silent degradation.
aj: Good call. Add a canary rollout plan: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with quality gating. Who owns rollout?
devon: I'll own rollout automation. Need config flags for model variants and fallback. Proposed PR: add variant tags `verdant-15b-fp16` and `verdant-15b-nf4`.
sophia: Heads-up: nvprof shows nvlink memory pressure for seq>1024 with nf4 KV caching. Might need smaller KV shards or different batching. I'll add microbench notes.
quant-bot: eval finished for nf4: relative MRR drop 1.5%, rouge-L -1.1%, semantic sim -0.9%. All within threshold.
maria: Customer OK with that. Can we get SLA docs and a timeline? They want ~2 week turnaround to production.
aj: Timeline: smoke perf + quant validations (2 days), privacy evals + hallucination checks (3 days), rollout automation & dedicated pool reserve (2-3 days), integration + compliance review (3-4 days). Total ~10-12 business days.
rachel: I found 3 prompts that trigger mild hallucination in nf4; will add to regression watchlist and create alert rule.
devon: Starting smoke run now. Logs: `init ok`, `warmup tok/s 4800`, `p95 180ms` on a single A100-80. Pushing for 2x concurrent jobs to validate 300 rps.
sophia: I'm adding a note: if we can't meet p95 <250 with nf4 at 300rps, fallback routing to fp16 is required and customer notified.
maria: Thanks team. I'll share this summary with customer and request signed DPA.
aj: Next steps assigned: devon (smoke + rollout), sophia (tokenizer + perf tuning), rachel (evals + alerts), quant-bot (artifact/quant jobs). Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
